product.title: Kennedy Space Center with Transport from Orlando and Kissimmee

description.text: Embark on the ultimate space adventure at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center, where you can explore a range of exciting tour options. Walk beneath the largest rocket ever flown, meet a veteran NASA astronaut, and get up close with Space Shuttle Atlantis. Experience the thrilling Shuttle Launch Experience and discover interactive exhibits that bring space exploration to life. Ideal for travelers basing in Orlando who want a guided Florida experience beyond the theme parks without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
